fact: Xaniko 在 Threadbare Hall 大门前叮嘱 Flann、Mearna、Diarban、Ivar 快而谨慎地赶路，说“小杂种”与其母可能已听到抢劫的风声。
anchor: Xaniko said to Flann, Mearna, Diarban, and Ivar at Threadbare Hall

fact: 双方实力悬殊：Flann 手下只有一百名匪徒（hundred bandits），Scaeth 有二千名装备精良的雇佣兵。
anchor: pitting our hundred bandits against his two thousand well-armed mercenaries

fact: Xaniko 很久以前与 Nakkiga 的诺恩女王（Norn Queen）决裂，离开后再不能回去，Sitha 一族也不接纳他，他最终来到 Crannhyr。
anchor: Xaniko had a falling out with the Norn Queen, that ancient horror in Nakkiga

fact: Flann 在山脊发现大批士兵，认出 Holly 徽记，判断是 First Lord（Phelan）的人，正像围猎的赶兽人一样扇面下山搜索。
anchor: I believe I saw the Holly badge, so they are likely the First Lord

fact: Flann 想起 Tethtain 祖父那一代此处有座旧铜矿，带众人躲进这座废弃矿坑当藏身处／据点。
anchor: there was an old copper mine near here during Tethtain

fact: 矿坑外室只有约两口棺材并列那么宽（two coffins），屋顶很低，连挥剑的空间都没有。
anchor: The chamber was about the width of two coffins laying side by side

fact: 一条大獒犬爬进矿洞口，Mearna 闻到恶臭的侧道里涌出 bukken（goblins），把獒犬活活撕碎；Ivar 大喊“Goblins! Run, damn it!”
anchor: the terrible sound of the mastiff being torn to pieces alive

fact: Flann 攀上坍塌的石堆垂下编好的藤索，众人从一处半塌的通风竖井爬出地面，再用大石封住洞口。
anchor: A half-collapsed airshaft. Thank all the gods for it.
